items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Rob Palmer, did you say you know him? He's living there, you say? In Chicago.

ctx.x: He was talking about the Kid Band with Joe Oliver.
Joe Oliver. Oh. Joe Oliver, oh. The only one I can know is uh, uh, uh, that's part of the name Rob Palmer. Mm-hmm. Cimbone player. Is he up there yet?
